---
title: "The Central Bank of Eve Online"
date: "2011-02-11"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets", "Monetary Policy"]
---

An inflation hawk tackles virtual [commodity price inflation](http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704132204576135931023983542.html?mod=WSJ_hps_sections_tech). The virtual world would seem to be a good place to test the macroeconomic implications of alternative monetary regimes.
